name: PrintableTools Lab Sponsor Opportunities

opportunities.title: PDF, Image, and QR SaaS Sponsorship
opportunities.audience: Visitors fixing PDF size limits, converting images, making static QR codes, and choosing no-upload browser utilities.
opportunities.sponsorFit: PDF APIs, image optimization tools, QR platforms, privacy-friendly document automation, browser utility products, and file-workflow SaaS.

opportunities.title: Resume and Career Tool Sponsorship
opportunities.audience: Job seekers creating resume PDFs, checking ATS keywords, fixing resume upload size limits, and preparing application documents.
opportunities.sponsorFit: Resume builders, ATS tools, job boards, interview prep products, career coaching, and applicant-document utilities.

opportunities.title: Classroom Printable Sponsorship
opportunities.audience: Teachers, homeschool families, and parents making free printable learning, planning, and classroom-management PDFs.
opportunities.sponsorFit: Teacher marketplaces, homeschool resources, classroom apps, learning printables, family routine products, and child-safe educational tools.

opportunities.title: Small Business Paperwork Sponsorship
opportunities.audience: Freelancers, local sellers, home-service operators, and small teams creating simple business PDFs and print assets.
opportunities.sponsorFit: Invoicing apps, bookkeeping tools, POS products, local marketing services, shipping tools, label systems, and small-business operations software.

opportunities.title: Local Marketing and QR Sponsorship
opportunities.audience: Local services, shops, event organizers, and small teams creating QR codes, flyers, coupons, signs, and printable promotion assets.
opportunities.sponsorFit: QR platforms, review-request tools, local SEO products, print shops, signage services, event tools, and small-business marketing software.

placements.name: Starter media review
placements.fit: A sponsor or partner wants a quick manual fit review before discussing placement.
placements.deliverable: Policy-fit check, suggested placement type, and a public-safe follow-up note.

placements.name: Guide sponsorship pilot
placements.fit: Useful products for privacy-friendly PDF, image, QR, career, classroom, or small-business workflows.
placements.deliverable: Clearly labeled sponsor mention on one relevant guide or resource page after approval.

placements.name: Partner distribution swap
placements.fit: Directories, newsletters, or communities that can send relevant visitors to free tools.
placements.deliverable: Tracked partner link and review of whether traffic creates depth, download, or lead signal.

rules: Use this board only for policy-fit sponsor and partner discovery.
Downloads stay free and cannot require ad clicks, sponsor interaction, accounts, or payment.
Sponsor copy must be clearly labeled and manually reviewed before placement.
Do not send payment, tax, bank, phone, private identity, passwords, or customer files through this site.
successGate: A real qualified sponsor inquiry, signed agreement, or settled external payment. Views and clicks alone are not revenue.
